Strangely serving no alcohol from their alcohol menu
Oct 2023 • Friends
This lounge looks lovely inside and out and appeared to be an ideal end of evening place for a cocktail.
We sat down outside, ordered 4 drinks and 2 desserts from their cake counter, the cakes came over and a different waiter came over and Google translated no to our drinks, we assumed he meant no to a particular drink but it was no to all alcoholic drinks! Unsure why even though they had a full drink menu they were not serving any at 9pm on a Tues evening. The coconut mousse cake was nice enough but we probably wouldn't have bothered if they had been more up front when we placed the order that we couldn't have the drinks we thought we had ordered.
